title: How old is your neighbourhood?
excerpt: Every home in England and Wales has a build period on the Council Tax list. I mapped all 35,672 small areas: 21% of homes predate 1919 and 12% were built since 2009. Cities grow in rings of age, until recently, when the newest homes started coming back to the middle.
seo_description: The age of the homes in every small area of England and Wales, mapped: 21% predate 1919, and cities grow in rings.
header_alt: Title card on light paper reading 'How old is your neighbourhood?' beside a map of England and Wales with every small area coloured from deep brown for Victorian homes to deep blue for homes built since 2009.
